correctness.rationale: For every n>=5, L=(2n-2)I-C^T C and CC^T=(n-2)I+11^T yield the exact 0,n,2n-2 eigenspaces. The symmetric PBH test reduces injectivity for the top eigenspace to the invertibility of the n-column unsigned incidence complement; with n edges this is exactly a spanning forest of odd-unicyclic components. The other eigenspace is killed precisely when the selected-edge graph has a balanced bipartite component compatible with the zero-sum potential. At the sharp n(n-3)/2 edge count, extremal graph density makes this possible only at n=6 with U=K3,3. Zero eigenvalue and n=3,4 are handled explicitly. The exponential formula counts these complements exactly. The verified reproducibility program reports VERIFY_OK 6600; finite checks support but do not prove the all-n result.

originality.rationale: The all-minimum-placements iff classification is distinct from the general geometric-multiplicity controller-count result in Yuan et al. (2013): the count alone is already implied and is not asserted as novel. The signless-incidence odd-unicyclic invertibility lemma is also known, as in Monfared–Mallik (2018). New assessed content is the exact simultaneous second-eigenspace test, its unique six-label K3,3 obstruction, an explicit optimum that is not zero forcing, and the exact labeled counting series. Inspected primary full-text sections and published semantic records did not exhibit equivalent statements; exhaustive historical coverage is not claimed.
residual_risks: Some specialist earlier graph-control articles, especially general controllability of undirected graphs (Farrugia–Sciriha 2014), were only available as abstracts; no unsupported whole-document exclusion is claimed.
A specific equivalent result could be indexed under triangular-graph leader sets, line-graph PBH observation, signless incidence matroids or zero-forcing variants not recovered in semantic searches.

General theory plus known graph spectra imply the optimal cardinality; originality depends specifically on the all-minimum-set structural classification, six-label exception, and exact enumeration rather than that cardinality.

value.rationale: The result classifies all minimum independently actuated vertex subsets of a natural strongly regular network, including one sharp exceptional obstruction missed by the top eigenspace alone. It provides an explicit optimal selector, a closed counting series and a mathematically meaningful separation from robust zero forcing: the exhibited optimal selector cannot perform any zero forcing move. This is a motivated complete classification rather than a small numerical improvement; the already-known minimum-count corollary is identified as prior coverage.
